available.quote: Electrical contractors who hold an electrical contractor or master electrician occupational or business license issued by any political subdivision in this state shall be eligible for a statewide license

requirements.value: Holders of a local electrical contractor or master electrician license must: provide evidence of passing a standardized written electrical assessment examination based on the National Electrical Code administered by an independent testing agency; provide evidence of 12,000 hours of verifiable practical experience or evidence of having been licensed by a Missouri political subdivision requiring examination as an electrical contractor or master electrician for 6 of the previous 8 calendar years; provide proof of required insurance; and proof that the local license was current, active, and not subject to discipline on the application date.
requirements.quote: Electrical contractors who hold an electrical contractor or master electrician occupational or business license issued by any political subdivision in this state shall be eligible for a statewide license if the applicant: (1) Provides evidence of having passed a standardized written electrical assessment examination that is based upon the National Electrical Code

is_mandatory.quote: Any person that knowingly violates any provision of sections 324.900 to 324.945 is guilty of a class B misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Does not hold himself or herself out as possessing a license required under sections 324.900 to 324.945 in this state

scope_protection.quote: If a corporation, firm, institution, organization, company, or representative thereof desires to engage in electrical contracting licensed under this chapter, then it shall have in its employ, at a supervisory level, at least one electrical contractor who possesses a statewide license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of guilty or plea of guilty/nolo contendere for a criminal offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The final adjudication and finding of guilty, or the entering of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state, of the United States, or of any country, for any offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a license or obtaining permission to take an examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing any license issued under sections 324.900 to 324.945 or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required under sections 324.900 to 324.945

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees or compensation by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition, or other compensation by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in the performance of professional functions and duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in the performance of the functions and duties of any profession licensed or regulated by sections 324.900 to 324.945

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of the statute or any lawful rule adopted thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 324.900 to 324.945 or any lawful rule adopted under sections 324.900 to 324.945

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of any person holding a license or allowing any person to use one's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a license or allowing any person to use his or her license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of a person as insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final adjudication of a person as insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice who is not registered and currently eligible to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by sections 324.900 to 324.945 who is not registered and currently eligible to practice under sections 324.900 to 324.945

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit, or license based upon a material mistake of fact

value: Employees of electric utilities, gas corporations, water corporations, cable television service providers, or telecommunications companies

Contractors servicing construction and maintenance of power lines or substations of electric utilities, municipal utilities, rural electric cooperatives, telecommunications companies, or cable television service providers
Federally licensed radio or television broadcast stations or commercial mobile radio service providers licensed by the FCC
Private broadcast engineering contractors with valid Society of Broadcast Engineers certification

Contractors engaged in design, installation, erection, repair, maintenance, or alteration of class two or class three remote control, signaling, or power-limited circuits, optical fiber cables or other cabling, or communications circuits including raceways for voice, video, audio, and data signals
scope_exclusions.quote: Sections 324.900 to 324.945 shall not apply to work done by: (1) Any employee of an electric utility, a gas corporation... (2) A railroad corporation; (3) A contractor who services the construction and maintenance of power lines or substations... (4) A federally licensed radio or television broadcast station... (5) A private broadcast engineering contractor possessing a valid Society of Broadcast Engineers certification; or (6) A contractor who is engaged in the design, installation, erection, repair, maintenance, or alteration of class two or class three remote control, signaling, or power-limited circuits
